name: Shiritarou ~Oshiri ga Michibiku Chindouchuu~
original_name: 尻太郎 ～お尻が導く珍道中～
source:
"I'm not a young lady. I'm a boy..."

A young man who's afraid of someone stalking him, Shiritaro,
visits the "Inui's Detective Agency", which is described as a " seemingly clumsy and unreliable place, but is actually a reliable detective agency."

For some reason, Inui is reluctant to accept the cry for help, but when he bites into the dumplings Shiritaro brought him as a gift,
an animalistic desire wells up from the depths of his gut, his crotch grows larger --
and Shiritaro approaches him...

A strange journey with a beautiful boy and three other men, START!
translation:
“我不是一个年轻的女士。我是一个男孩……”

害怕有人跟踪自己的年轻人尻太郎，
探访“干的侦探社”，被描述为“看似笨拙且不可靠的地方，但实际上是可靠的侦探社”。

不知为何，干不愿意接受呼救声，但当他咬下白太郎送给他的饺子时，
一种兽性的欲望从他的肠道深处涌出，他的胯部变大——
尻太郎向他靠近……

与一个美丽的男孩和另外三个男人的奇怪旅程，开始！
